notes.notes:

notes.title: The application is not abandoned! (v 1.1)
notes.notes:
They did not expect? :)

- We have a big update, fixed minor technical errors.
- Tutoril control was added (There are 2 languages, in the future we will make a tutorial on our website, so that you can learn the control through a translator)
- Also now our application has moved to the "program" section

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33600801/e24d6cf0ee8e1c7fd7bf48222c3d52c85d70b301.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33600801/027e7fe6547dfb809ba301b4319a45fefe3048b5.gif[/img]

We thought that our application failed in sales, for 2 months we tried to recoup the first installment for Steam ...

But some kind of magic changed everything a bit, and the application began to bring us a small profit (NDA)

Thank you for buying! , we appreciate it. More bug fixes and content refinement will come soon!
